user.title: HA-nnounce
user.description: Record your voice from the phone or the browser and play it on your speakers: Google Home and Nest, Sonos, ESPHome and every media player that plays audio from Home Assistant. You can change these settings later.

data.announce_volume: Use the announcement volume of the speaker

data_description.speakers: Leave empty to offer every speaker of a supported integration (Google Cast, Sonos, ESPHome, DLNA, Music Assistant and more), televisions excluded. Choose here to add other media players, such as those of custom integrations.
data_description.set_volume: The speaker goes back to its own volume when the message ends.
data_description.announce_volume: On Sonos, Music Assistant, Squeezebox and Bang & Olufsen the message plays at its own volume over the music, and the volume of the music is not touched. Off: the speaker volume is changed and then restored, like on the others.
data_description.resume_playback: On speakers without native announcement mode (such as Google Cast and DLNA), tries to resume directly playable streams, URLs, and media sources after the message ends. App sessions like Spotify or YouTube Music cannot be resumed.
data_description.custom_chime: Optional local audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG...) inside an allowed folder (allowlist_external_dirs). Enables the Custom option in the chime selector.
data_description.normalize: Makes quiet and loud recordings sound the same.
data_description.voice_enhancement: Applies microphone noise suppression, echo cancellation, auto gain, high-pass filter, and silence trimming. Turn off for raw, unprocessed audio.
data_description.tts_entity: Optional TTS entity for text announcements. Leave empty to use Home Assistant's default TTS engine.
data_description.quiet_hours: Limit volume or skip speakers during the configured schedule or while the quiet hours entity is on.
data_description.quiet_mode: Choose whether to cap announcement volume or skip affected speakers during quiet hours.
data_description.quiet_speakers: Leave empty to apply quiet hours to every speaker.
data_description.quiet_entity: Optional input_boolean or binary_sensor that activates quiet hours whenever it is on.
data_description.intercom: Adds one camera per speaker with a talk button, using Home Assistant's two-way audio (Settings > System > Labs). Installs aiortc the first time.
data_description.alexa_support: Adds Amazon Echo speakers from the Alexa Devices or Alexa Media Player integrations using SSML audio. Requires an external HTTPS URL reachable by Amazon (Home Assistant Cloud or public HTTPS domain).

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: Plays a text message, audio file, or URL on speakers, with the chime and volume of announcements.

message.name: Message
message.description: Text to speak using Home Assistant's text-to-speech engine.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of an audio file in a folder Home Assistant may read.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of an audio file to download.

tts_entity.name: TTS engine
tts_entity.description: Optional text-to-speech entity to use for message. Empty uses the integration or Home Assistant default.

language.name: Language
language.description: Optional language code passed to the text-to-speech engine.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Volume while playing. Empty uses the integration setting.

chime.name: Chime
chime.description: Chime before the audio. Empty uses the integration setting.

force.name: Ignore quiet hours
force.description: Play at full requested volume on all speakers even during quiet hours.

replay.name: Replay last message
replay.description: Plays the last message again (messages are kept for one hour).
